hello.text: Oh, sorry, I didn't see you. I'm Tam. I, um. I just got back from the vale.

t0.text: Yes. No. Sorry. Something followed me up. Something dead. I keep thinking I can hear it.

t1.text: Farms, the lake, Lakeford. It used to be quiet. People say the old barrows aren't quiet anymore. Sorry. I shouldn't scare you.
